description: Access Dun & Bradstreet's China business database through natural language. This service provides indexing of company basic information and structured profile data, supporting entity identification and matching (quickly locating target companies through multi-criteria fuzzy search), as well as the creation of foundational company profiles covering key dimensions such as registration information, ownership structure, and organizational structure.
